sources.finding: Entry points build, plan, resolve (update existing PR: merge base, fix CI, answer review comments), resume_build (from checkpoint.json) and execute; optional HAX plan approval gate pauses the workflow.

sources.title: Discovery surface metadata
sources.finding: Entrypoint tag marks build, implement_issue, plan, resolve and resume_build for discovery via af ls --entrypoints; internal role reasoners are tagged and described as do-not-call-directly.

sources.title: DAG executor
sources.locator: _save_checkpoint, bounded concurrency with asyncio.Semaphore, worktree helpers, level execution
sources.finding: Executes issues by dependency level, caps parallel issues with a semaphore, persists DAGState to .artifacts/execution/checkpoint.json after levels, uses git worktrees per issue.

sources.title: Per-issue coding loop
sources.locator: module docstring; _call_with_timeout; default and flagged paths
sources.finding: Inner loop: coder then reviewer (two calls) or coder then QA plus reviewer plus synthesizer when needs_deeper_qa; 2700 s default call timeout; middle advisor and outer replanner loops.

sources.title: Issue-level build schemas
sources.finding: implement_issue accepts an issue with title, description, acceptance criteria, files and testing strategy; config includes verify, enable_github_pr, agent_timeout_seconds=1800, max_coding_iterations=3, keep_worktree.

sources.title: implement_issue entry point
sources.finding: Creates its own git worktree and issue/<build_id>-<slug> branch from base_branch, runs the coder-reviewer loop, optional verifier, removes the worktree and returns branch, commits and files changed without touching the caller checkout.

sources.title: Post-PR CI gate
sources.finding: After the PR is pushed, watches gh pr checks with poll and wall-clock caps and runs a bounded fix-and-repush agent that must not silence tests.

sources.title: Human-in-the-loop ask_user form and pause
sources.finding: When HAX_API_KEY is set, planning and scout roles can request a Hax form; the workflow pauses via app.pause until a person responds or the request expires; without the key the gate is disabled.
